      "rationale": "It fixes Guix Windows codesigning by updating to osslsigncode 2.14 and adding post-signing verification in an offline container. Release integrity is the top priority in build, and verifying signatures before shipping release binaries avoids releasing broken signatures."

      "rationale": "Mechanical release artifacts and notes do not make a PR a member of docs."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/torcontrol.cpp to fix Tor control port reconnection logic.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "It applies exponential reconnect backoff to dropped Tor control port connections. Dropped or closed connections previously retried without backoff, causing rapid reconnect attempts."
    },
